entries.title: PostReady: PR #662 — fix(video): actually force animated frames
entries.description: Fixed animated-scene frames still rendering as photoreal despite the Animated scenes rebrand. Animated art-direction is now correctly enforced through the frame-generation pipeline.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #713 — feat(pivot): hide customer video behind kill-switch (epic #663 A1)
entries.description: Strategic product pivot: customer video gated behind NEXT_PUBLIC_VIDEO_ENABLED kill-switch (default OFF). All video entry points hidden without deleting code — fully reversible. Video engine preserved for future Bring to Life feature.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #752 — feat(carousel): Carousel Creator editor on the Create tab (epic #663 workstream D)
entries.description: First build of the Carousel Creator — a horizontal-filmstrip editor living on the Create page as a new "Create Carousel" tab. Filmstrip with drag-to-reorder, per-card delete, Add card menu (AI / text / photo / CTA / duplicate / blank), editable card canvas, and inspector panel.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #753 — fix(carousel): preview stepping + add-card menu; remove Videos from Batch
entries.description: Fixed carousel preview not refreshing when stepping through cards (editable prop on CardFace), repaired add-card menu, and removed Videos from Batch mode — post-launch polish for the Carousel Creator.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #754 — feat(carousel): curated color palettes + custom accent
entries.description: Added curated color palette presets and a custom accent color picker to the Carousel Creator editor, enabling branded palette selection per carousel.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #755 — feat(carousel): redesign to guide — dark header, tabbed inspector, zoom, card-to-top
entries.description: Carousel Creator redesigned with a guided layout: dark header, tabbed inspector panel, zoom controls, and card-to-top navigation — improving the editor UX for building multi-card carousels.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #756 — feat(carousel): real AI generation — whole carousel from a prompt + per-card rewrite
entries.description: Carousel Creator now generates full carousels from a prompt using AI, with per-card rewrite capability — converting it from a manual editor into an AI-first content creation tool.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #757 — feat(carousel): Save — autosave drafts + reload on open
entries.description: Second step of Generate → Save → Publish: carousel work persists. Adds carousels table (migration 68), /api/carousel/draft GET/PUT endpoint, and autosave on every edit with reload on re-open.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #758 — fix(carousel): move card actions off card, merge AI buttons, bigger logo
entries.description: Moved per-card action buttons off the card canvas to avoid overlap with content, merged the two AI action buttons into one, and increased logo size in the Carousel Creator editor.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #759 — feat(carousel): Stage 1 publish — render cards to real PNGs + Download
entries.description: Stage 1 of the Carousel Creator Publish step: renders each carousel card to a real PNG via canvas capture and bundles them into a ZIP for download. Generate → Save → Publish pipeline now has all three stages functional.
